title: Parity holonomy in Boolean constraint networks: a reproduction study of five claims, one refutation, and a checksum that is not a memory
description: An independent reproduction of the five verdicts published by the kostyk348/paradox-logic repository, which formalises 'paradox as foundation' over GF(2). Six experiments are re-run from a pinned commit; all six outputs are byte-identical to the result files committed with the code. The identification of paradox with Mermin/GHZ contextuality and the author's own refutation of his cohomological diagonal lemma are confirmed. The parity invariant is reproduced and sharpened: it survives value noise completely, degrades under structural noise, and as an error-correcting object has minimum distance one, which makes it a checksum rather than a memory. The deposit contains the experiment plan, the harness (Rust, standard library only), every raw log, every committed result compared byte for byte, the number ledger, and the LaTeX source.
notes: Every number in the paper is generated by the accompanying harness from raw logs; every reference was resolved by a machine query before it was cited. Two of the five claims were not re-run for runtime reasons and are labelled as such. See verify_all.sh.
